name: Treasury Trade Settlement Status
definition: Specifies the status of a treasury trade at a specified time.

TradeStatus.name: Trade Status
TradeStatus.definition: Status of a treasury trade in a central matching/settlement system.

AllegedTrade.name: Alleged Trade
AllegedTrade.definition: Specifies whether a trade is alleged (notified by the counterparty) or not.

Settlement.name: Settlement
Settlement.definition: Specifies the status of a settlement eg rejected, settled or awaiting authorisation.

RejectedAmount.name: Rejected Amount
RejectedAmount.definition: Amount that cannot be settled for instance by a settlement system.

SettlementDate.name: Settlement Date
SettlementDate.definition: Date on which the trade is actually settled.

WithdrawalReason.name: Withdrawal Reason
WithdrawalReason.definition: Reason that an alleged trade is withdrawn.

TreasuryTrade.name: Treasury Trade
TreasuryTrade.definition: Treasury trade for which a settlement status is provided.
